newsitem.title: FRANCE: French troops join UAE army in Gulf manoeuvres.
newsitem.headline: French troops join UAE army in Gulf manoeuvres.

text.p: Over 600 French troops and 160 vehicles backed by 18 aircraft and three ships are engaged in combined exercises in the Gulf with the United Arab Emirates army, France's Defence Ministry said on Wednesday.
The Gulf-96 exercise, from October 19-29, is the largest such manoeuvre in the region this year to be joined by French forces, a ministry statement said.
"It confirms the role our country wants to play in this part of the world and underlines our desire to develop military cooperation with the UAE," the statement said.

President Jacques Chirac is currently on a Middle East tour, his third to the area this year, and has stressed Paris' desire for a European role in the region. His current tour does not include the UAE.
The UAE, linked to Paris by a defence pact, is a major French arms client, having already purchased planes, helicopters and tanks.
